holder.name: Arvind Kejriwal
holder.note: Observed on 7 October 2013: the party's NRI release of that date styles him 'AAP’s National Convener' (raw Internet Archive capture of nri.aamaadmiparty.org); the earliest single-day party record adopted for him in the period.
holder.uncertainty: No start: the party's letter of 29 May 2015 to the Election Commission recalls the first election of office bearers, with him as National Convenor, on 25.11.2012, an election that is not a start. No end: no record reviewed states the day this term ended; his re-election with effect from 27 April 2016 is a separate holder observation and is not used as an end.

holder.name: Arvind Kejriwal
holder.note: From 27 April 2016: the certified excerpt of the National Executive's minutes of that day, filed with the Election Commission on 31 May 2016, records his election as National Convener 'W.E.F. 27.04.2016'.
holder.uncertainty: No end: party records style him National Convenor on 12 November 2016, 18 December 2022, 18 November 2024 and 25 August 2026, and the Commission's catalogue names him National Convener on 20 January 2017, all claims; no record reviewed states the day this term ended, and his re-election reported on 10 September 2026 falls after the cutoff.

holder.name: Mayawati
holder.note: Observed on 16 July 2012: the party's letter of that date to the Chief Election Commissioner, on her letterhead as National President and signed by her, encloses the list of office bearers naming 'Km. Mayawati' as National President (reproduced in the Election Commission's compilation PPS2_01032013).
holder.uncertainty: No start: the party's 2009 pages recall that she 'Assumed the office' of National President on 18 September 2003, that the party 'made her its National President' that day and that she was re-elected on 27 August 2006; these retrospective entries are claims and are not used as a start. No end: the Election Commission's catalogue (15 April 2019) and the party's press note of 1 September 2021 style her National President (claims), and no record reviewed states an end.

holder.name: Conrad K. Sangma
holder.note: Observed on 11 July 2020: the party's press release of that date says its digital conclave held 'today' was attended by 'the National President Conrad K. Sangma' (raw Internet Archive capture of nppindia.in); the earliest single-day party record adopted for him.
holder.uncertainty: No start: the party's pages say he was elected National President 'in March 2016' after his father's death, without a day. No end: his signed notifications of 4 February 2022 and 17 April 2025 as National President are claims, and no record reviewed states an end.
